correctness.rationale: For every agent, RSD assigns a top-k object whenever that agent is among the first k priority positions, so own top-k probability is at least k/n. With two preference types A,B and multiplicities r,s, equal treatment of equals and feasibility give r xA(T)+s xB(T)=k for every A-top-k set. Therefore s(xA(T)-xB(T))=n xA(T)-k>=0, with the symmetric argument for B. Exact enumeration independently gives 72/216 failures at n=3, all using three preference types, in two S3xS3 classes.
